card.name: Across or among after a risk noun
card.fires_on: The words "across" and "among" right after a noun like suicidality or interaction, introducing a comparison between groups of drugs or indications in label text.

modes.label: across after risk
modes.description: "across" follows a risk noun and leads into different indications.
modes.example: There were differences in absolute risk of suicidality<< across>> the different indications, with the highest incidence

modes.label: among after interaction
modes.description: "among" follows "interaction" in the overdosage advice and leads into "drugs".
modes.example: consider the possibility of multiple drug overdoses, interaction<< among>> drugs and unusual drug kinetics in your patient

card.plain: It fires on the little word "across" or "among" that introduces a comparison between drugs or conditions.
evidence: There were differences in absolute risk of suicidality<< across>> the different indications, with the highest incidence
In managing overdosage, consider the possibility of multiple drug overdoses, interaction<< among>> drugs and unusual drug kinetics in your patient
